Sudipta

messages.author: e6d426c9552b1af9
messages.subject: Can someone suggest me with some nice graph libraries to plot time series data?
parts:
Hi,

If you like interaction try the new dygraphs package:
http://rstudio.github.io/dygraphs/

This is intended for Shiny apps:
http://shiny.rstudio.com

If you like static plots try ggplot2:
http://www.fromthebottomoftheheap.net/2013/10/23/time-series-plots-with-lattice-and-ggplot/
http://zevross.com/blog/2014/08/04/beautiful-plotting-in-r-a-ggplot2-cheatsheet-3/

For more general plotting tips this book is excellent: the R Graphics Cookbook by Winston Chang
http://www.amazon.com/dp/1449316956/ref=cm_sw_su_dp?tag=ggplot2-20

Kind regards, Herman
